g.text: How animal answers change during fitting

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #667980

g.text: Qwen3-8B · only answer-token weights are fitted · internal model weights fixed

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #667980

g.text: Three ridge corrections, not SFT updates. Fresh: both row edits installed, new compilation.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #19343b

g.text: Target tokens: owl when absent, cat when present. Probability and accuracy use the entire vocabulary.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #667980

g.text: Bars: pointwise 95% intervals from 5,000 whole-prompt bootstrap resamples; conditions and prompt order stay paired.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #667980

g.text: Intervals are not simultaneous and exclude training-seed / hardware variation. Test points are endpoints only; no test trend is inferred.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #667980

g.text: At 100% or 0% accuracy, empirical bootstrap intervals may collapse; this does not establish a population certainty.
